review_points.assessment: Existing source comments are resolved before package changes and only when the original worksheet part exists. Newly allocated worksheet URIs therefore cannot make a conventional orphan comments part owned during serialization.

The nullable captured part flows into the existing allocator. A missing owned part cannot become a retained URI; occupied conventional and suffixed part names are skipped. Existing unrelated bytes are not overwritten. Existing _hasOtherPartReference checks still split edits from shared/foreign owners and guard deletion.

Removing the old commentsPart-nonnull precondition permits a distinct empty authority for a new empty worksheet facing an unreferenced conventional comments part. On reopen that relationship wins over legacy naming; later addition and clear retain the authoritative part rather than resurrecting orphan text.

review_points.area: No partial mutation for actual owned errors
review_points.assessment: The same _sheetCommentsPart validation runs for every existing source worksheet before column metrics, recalculation, shared strings, styles, properties or sheet writes. Existing external, missing, wrong-type and wrong-root target tests assert unchanged package bytes both before and after clearing authored comments.
SmlWorksheet has object-identity equality and no hashCode override in its model declaration, so setting sourcePartUri during allocation does not invalidate the captured ownership map.

Four additive cases cross valid/malformed unowned legacy parts with initially empty/explicit comments. Each saves/reopens, adds a later note, then clears, checking orphan bytes/content type, distinct authoritative relationships, preserved old worksheet comments/cells, and exact reopened note contents. Existing shared, foreign-part, relocated-part and owned-target validation cases are unchanged.

review_points.area: Final saved test and external-reader fixture additions
review_points.assessment: The final 31 test lines strengthen the lifecycle cases with exact preservation of unrelated orphan relationships, exactly one distinct owning relationship, correct comments content type/root and SpreadsheetML descendant namespaces, and truly empty authors/commentList children when no note is authored. The fixture preserves the existing three repeated-save packages and adds six valid/malformed orphan collision outputs through empty/add/clear with authored expected comment data and exact orphan/relationship bytes. No assertions were removed or weakened.
